scientific_identity.fixed_baseline_definition: Autoregression is the fixed matched baseline for all qualitative cases, not necessarily the lowest-error non-proposed or additive control. No ownership-based ranking category is used.
scientific_identity.secondary: No-tanh ablation (unbounded_transport / unbounded_spatial_mix), selected after development and frozen before reserved access; not silently promoted to the primary method.

scope: Completed DROID original development native feature forecasts and reserved IWS transfer forecasts; no new inference or scientific source edits.

selection_policy.comparison: One fixed matched baseline: autoregression across every case and task. Show bounded and no-tanh predictions in those same cases; do not switch baseline by case. The fixed baseline is not an ownership-based best-control claim.
selection_policy.failure_visibility: Retain largest, median, and smallest-gain cases. Call smallest largest regression only when measured negative. A positive selected episode can have a negative earliest-window effect.
selection_policy.fixed_models: DROID ranks bounded primary versus AR; IWS ranks no-tanh secondary versus AR. Keep study and variant labels explicit.
selection_policy.maps: Use measured patch errors on one common scale and actual learned transport/gate values; transport weights are not optical flow, ground-truth correspondence, or proof of causal explanation.
selection_policy.not_allowed: No visual case reselection, no per-case comparator switching, no hallucinated attention maps, no generated image as prediction evidence, no significance claim from rounded means.
selection_policy.posthoc_status: This closest-comparator audit and IWS qualitative selection are post-hoc descriptive diagnostics of completed experiments, not a preregistered test. DROID AR episode rule already exists in the earlier spatial qualitative protocol.
selection_policy.selection: For each task, rank all episodes by saved endpoint relative MSE gain over fixed autoregression; descending gain, ascending episode-ID ties; ranks 0, floor((N-1)/2), N-1.
selection_policy.window: Smallest eligible saved window_start; selected episode gain and shown first-window gain must both be labeled.

verification.confidence_intervals: Copied verbatim from completed paired analyses, never reconstructed from rounded table values. DROID absolute-difference intervals and IWS relative-gain intervals have different units.

wording_revision.reason: Remove ambiguous strongest non-ours category: additive controls outperform AR in DROID. AR remains the fixed matched comparison for unchanged case selection.
